name: zvid_image_set_pixels
description: zVid_Image::SetPixels stores pixel and alpha-map pointers and sets the alpha-present flag when an alpha map is supplied.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ec70 validates storing pixels and alphaMap, ORing formatFlagsPacked with 0x02 only when alphaMap is non-null, and returning zero.
The native zVid image helper smokes verify pointer storage, alpha-present flag behavior, and the no-alpha path.
